headline-narrow.purpose: Headline below the wide desktop breakpoint.

headline-stacked.purpose: Headline after the docs and stage stack.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Small interface movement and damped arrival.

components.name: Primary Documentation Action
components.description: A cobalt, fully labeled action for the principal documentation route.
components.css: .ds-action { min-width: 132px; height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--gnomon-radius); color: var(--gnomon-white); background: var(--gnomon-cobalt); font: 500 8px/1 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease, transform 140ms var(--gnomon-ease-out); } .ds-action:hover { background: var(--gnomon-cobalt-deep); } .ds-action:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gnomon-ink); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px var(--gnomon-acid); }

components.name: Adapter Segmented Control
components.description: A ruled framework switch with one committed active field.
components.css: .ds-segment { display: inline-grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; border: 1px solid var(--gnomon-hairline-strong); } .ds-segment button { min-width: 74px; height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; color: var(--gnomon-ink); background: transparent; font: 500 8px/1 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace; cursor: pointer; } .ds-segment button + button { border-left: 1px solid var(--gnomon-hairline-strong); } .ds-segment button[data-state='active'] { color: var(--gnomon-white); background: var(--gnomon-cobalt); } .ds-segment button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gnomon-ink); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px var(--gnomon-acid); }

components.name: Primitive Tree Row
components.description: A semantic component node with a visible registration endpoint.
components.css: .ds-primitive { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 18px 1fr 12px; gap: 8px; align-items: center; width: 280px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--gnomon-cobalt); border-radius: 0; color: var(--gnomon-ink); background: var(--gnomon-white); text-align: left; font: 500 10px/1 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace; } .ds-primitive span { color: var(--gnomon-cobalt); } .ds-primitive i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--gnomon-acid); background: var(--gnomon-acid); } .ds-primitive:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gnomon-ink); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px var(--gnomon-acid); }

components.name: Stage Status Rail
components.description: The compact rail that proves renderer, collection, and selected state.
components.css: .ds-status { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; align-items: center; height: 46px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gnomon-hairline); color: var(--gnomon-ink); background: var(--gnomon-mineral); font: 500 7px/1 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace; } .ds-status span { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; padding: 0 28px; } .ds-status span:nth-child(2) { justify-content: center; } .ds-status span:last-child { justify-content: flex-end; } .ds-status i { width: 7px; height: 7px; background: var(--gnomon-acid); } .ds-status strong { color: var(--gnomon-acid-ink); }

components.name: Selection Inspector
components.description: A square instrument panel for selection state and navigation.
components.css: .ds-inspector { width: 238px; border: 1px solid var(--gnomon-hairline-strong); border-radius: 0; color: var(--gnomon-ink); background: var(--gnomon-white); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace; } .ds-inspector small { display: block; padding: 15px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gnomon-hairline); font-size: 7px; } .ds-inspector h3 { margin: 0; padding: 16px 15px 4px; font: 620 24px/1 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-inspector p { margin: 0; padding: 5px 15px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gnomon-hairline); font-size: 7px; } .ds-inspector strong { color: var(--gnomon-acid-ink); } .ds-inspector dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; margin: 0; padding: 12px 15px; font-size: 7px; } .ds-inspector dd { margin: 0; } .ds-inspector div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; border-top: 1px solid var(--gnomon-hairline-strong); } .ds-inspector button { min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; font: 500 7px/1 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace; } .ds-inspector button + button { border-left: 1px solid var(--gnomon-hairline-strong); }

components.name: Object Index Rail
components.description: A numbered collection rail with one taller active registration mark.
components.css: .ds-index { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); align-items: end; width: 420px; height: 44px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gnomon-hairline-strong); } .ds-index button { position: relative; height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; font: 500 7px/1 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace; } .ds-index i { position: absolute; bottom: -1px; left: 50%; width: 1px; height: 7px; background: var(--gnomon-ink); opacity: .45; } .ds-index button[data-state='active'] { color: var(--gnomon-cobalt); } .ds-index button[data-state='active'] i { width: 2px; height: 23px; background: var(--gnomon-cobalt); opacity: 1; }

narrative.overview: Gnomon UI feels designed by the people who build museum display systems and precision developer tools. Mineral surfaces, cobalt structural fields, acid status marks, aluminum gnomons, rulers, axes, and square controls make the interface feel physical without imitating a desktop editor. Component anatomy and spatial output are one system. Lines explain selection, measure, hierarchy, focus, or code-to-scene correspondence; they are never added as technical decoration. The visual system is precise, direct, and quietly confident.
keyCharacteristics: Bright mineral atmosphere with one committed cobalt structural field.
Flat DOM surfaces connected to a dimensional, object-led WebGL stage.
Archivo wayfinding paired with JetBrains Mono instrument readouts.
Hairlines, registration marks, and measurement rails instead of floating cards.
Framework code, semantic state, and spatial selection remain visibly connected.

rules.name: The Committed Cobalt Rule
rules.body: Cobalt owns substantial functional regions rather than appearing as scattered accent confetti.

rules.name: The Reinforced State Rule
rules.body: Color never carries state alone; copy, position, outline, or iconography must confirm it.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Archivo carries meaning and navigation; JetBrains Mono carries system evidence. Mono is never decorative texture.

rules.name: The Flat Instrument Rule
rules.body: A DOM surface may overlap another surface, but it does not float through a generic box shadow.

dos: Do demonstrate real APIs and state changes in every example.
Do let one cobalt structural field carry the composition's visual energy.
Do use measurement and registration only when they explain relationships.
Do author synthetic objects with enough specificity to feel real.
Do keep React, Vue, DOM fallback, and WebGL selection behavior equivalent.
donts: Don't make books the product identity; they are one demo object type.
Don't turn every data point into a badge or rounded card.
Don't scatter decorative axes, rulers, or code fragments without meaning.
Don't copy Stripe Press typography, palette, imagery, or page structure.
Don't hide essential navigation behind unlabeled icons.
